page.overview:
Who is Arecelis Acosta?

Arecelis Acosta was a male Coynite-Human hybrid who was a member of the Rebel Alliance Harrier Infiltration Team where he served as the technical officer for the group. During a mission to Nysza III to destroy an Imperial communications bunker, Officer Acosta was killed by the Dark Jedi Vialco.
